summary: A verbatim restyle keeps one source page per slide, always; a page that does not fit the template is made to fit by a deterministic ladder that compacts the template's chrome, then sets the page at its own source type size, then falls back to the page's own geometry, and never fails on geometry.
invariants: Slide count equals source page count; no continuation slides, no merges.
Source text is never hidden, truncated, shortened or reordered to make a page fit.

The ladder buys room by shrinking the template's footprint before it shrinks the text: dense variant, type scale to the 15px/12px design floor, chrome compaction (title band to one line, footer band to one line, margins 64 to 24px), then source-relative type, then source geometry.
At rungs 4 and 5 text may be set below the 15px design floor, but never below the page's own source size times 0.9; the rung reached is recorded per slide in the quality receipt.
Title typography and position are identical at every rung so pages set at different rungs read as one deck.

Rung 5 (source geometry) uses the source page's rectangles as the terminal fit, with template colors, type family, accent and side bands; it is never chosen as the design basis for a page that fits an earlier rung.
Fit is estimated from font metrics, rendered by the server, and confirmed once in Chromium per step; a measured defect is a renderer bug to fix in code, never a reason for a provider repair call.
forbidden: Producing more or fewer slides than source pages.
Failing a deck because a page cannot fit at the design floor.
Asking a provider to rewrite or re-layout a page to make it fit.
Setting any text below 0.9 times its source size.
rationale: The user decided on 2026-09-04 that the original document had one page and the result must have one slide: grow the box or set the type at the original size, but never split.

The previous contract fixed verbatim text, page count, no expansion and overflow_policy same_page_recompose_or_fail at once, with a 15px floor and template chrome on top; a 10pt, 400-character source page has no solution under those constraints, and both engines failed on it (authored: 0 of 43 verbatim restyle operations since 2026-08-28; source-native: source_verbatim_same_page_capacity_exceeded, source_native_sentence_capacity_exceeded).

Rung 5 terminates because the source page laid this content out at this size once already; a uniform scale of that layout always fits. The allocator already names the mode (placement_strategy sourceGeometry) and the manifest already carries the rectangles.
Chrome compaction comes before any text change because the template bands cost about 40% of the content area (1152x544 at level 0 versus 1232x648 at level 3).

supersedes.narrowedClause: '원본 도형과 기존 슬라이드 레이아웃을 디자인 기반으로 재사용하지 않는다' stays for pages that fit rungs 0-4 and is narrowed to permit source geometry as the terminal rung; SourceContentPolicy.overflow_policy gains same_page_fit_ladder.
